title: Spudlight — Source, Signal, Storage, Reflection and Revelation Research Program
status: project archaeology + typed physical/information models + historical symbolic comparison
abstract: Spudlight is most scientifically useful when treated not as one new physical substance but as a typed source-to-observer architecture. In different domains the source variable may be photon flux, chemical free energy, a message distribution, attention, or another explicitly defined signal; each retains its own units and governing laws. The physical-light branch uses ordinary electromagnetism and photon budgets. The Starchforce branch is recast as storage/release dynamics, where incoming energy or material is accumulated, transformed and later mobilized. The information branch describes how a source is transmitted through a noisy channel and changes an observer's posterior beliefs or decision state. Reflection and mediation can then be represented by transfer functions/channels rather than by assuming a second fundamental force. The project-specific contribution is the repeated source→mediator→observer→state-change grammar and its coupling to storage, Door and Eye concepts. Its scientific maturity is T1-T2: the architecture is rigorous enough to instantiate in real optical, biological or communication systems, but there is no evidence for a distinct fundamental Spudlight particle/field, and symbolic/revelatory meanings remain separate from measurable energy or information quantities.
research_question: Can the recurring Spudlight/Starchforce vocabulary be decomposed into domain-specific source, channel, storage, observation and decision variables so that each branch becomes quantitatively testable without conflating photons, information, attention and spiritual meaning?
epistemic_rule: Spudlight is Potatoverse theology/symbolism at the project level. Keep physical sunlight, electromagnetic radiation, chemical storage, information, social attention, historical occult correspondence and spiritual revelation in separate typed variables. Tim=Sun/Center/Spudlight is not an astronomical claim that Tim is the physical Sun or solar-system barycenter.
maturity: T1-T2 typed systems framework; no new fundamental force/field established

typed_master_chain.form: source X -> channel H -> received signal Y -> observation/inference O -> decision or Door D -> changed state X'
typed_master_chain.with_storage: source/input J_in -> storage K -> release J_out -> channel/observer
typed_master_chain.rule: H, X, Y, N and K must be instantiated separately in every domain. The same symbols do not imply identical physics.

project_vertical_light_model.upper_circle: inner/source domain: Heaven, Garden, Spirit, Father's House and Sun/Spudlight field centered on Father/Tim at C_F
project_vertical_light_model.lower_circle: outer/manifestation domain: Earth, matter, world, embodied presence and broad multiplicity centered on Son/Thomas at C_S
project_vertical_light_model.door: Mandorla conversion field where inner/source becomes accessible as present/manifest relation without source and world collapsing into sameness
project_vertical_light_model.sun: source-light comparator placed at/through Father-center rather than at lower circumference
project_vertical_light_model.moon: secondary reflected/cyclical mediator best modeled near/on the lower-circle circumference or as an orbital operator around Earth/world rather than another source-center
project_vertical_light_model.plane: world interface through O, where source signals become observation/action/history
project_vertical_light_model.axis: bidirectional source↔manifestation relation through Son, O and Father
project_vertical_light_model.boundary: This is project geometry/theology, not an empirical optical coordinate system.

equations: I(r)=P/(4 pi r^2) for an ideal isotropic source
physical_light_layer.meaning: Physical light carries energy, momentum and information. It can support photosynthesis and sensing but is not itself identical to meaning, authority, attention or revelation.
physical_light_layer.limiting_conditions: Inverse-square intensity applies only to an ideal isotropic source in an unobstructed geometry; real optical systems require aperture, absorption, scattering and directional emission.

source_channel_observer_model.capacity: C=max_p(x) I(X;Y) under specified channel/input constraints
source_channel_observer_model.identifiability_warning: Observed output y generally cannot uniquely determine source x, channel H and noise n simultaneously without calibration, priors, repeated measurements or interventions.
source_channel_observer_model.project_value: Revelation becomes scientifically tractable only in the narrow sense of information gain or state change relative to a declared observer/model.

starchforce_storage_release.interpretation: Starchforce is scientifically strongest as a storage/release abstraction, not a fifth fundamental force.
starchforce_storage_release.solution_constant_input: For constant J_in=J0, K(t)=K_inf+[K(0)-K_inf] exp[-(eta+Gamma)t], with K_inf=J0/(eta+Gamma)
starchforce_storage_release.runway_no_input: If J_in=0 and J_out=eta K, K decays exponentially; a chosen viability threshold K_min gives t_run=ln[K(0)/K_min]/(eta+Gamma)
starchforce_storage_release.units_rule: K and fluxes must carry domain-specific units: joules for an energy store, kilograms/moles for matter, bytes/bits only for digital storage, currency for financial stock, etc.

sunlight_hidden_in_matter.project_phrase: Potato as sunlight hidden/stored in matter.
sunlight_hidden_in_matter.physical_neighbor: Photosynthesis captures a fraction of incident solar energy into chemical free energy; plant carbon metabolism and transport allocate assimilated carbon into structural biomass, respiration and storage such as tuber starch.
sunlight_hidden_in_matter.typed_chain: solar radiation -> photosynthetic assimilation -> transported carbon -> starch/tuber storage -> respiration/remobilization/growth
sunlight_hidden_in_matter.stock_flow: dM_C/dt=J_assim-J_resp-J_tuber-J_structural-J_other; individual terms must be measured/defined for a biological model
sunlight_hidden_in_matter.boundary: Chemical free energy is measurable; memory, love, meaning and moral debt are not joules.

information_bottleneck_upgrade.question: What information should pass through a limited representation while discarding irrelevant variation?
information_bottleneck_upgrade.formal_neighbor: Seek a representation T that compresses X while preserving information relevant to target Y, often expressed through a tradeoff between I(X;T) and I(T;Y).
information_bottleneck_upgrade.project_use: This offers a disciplined version of 'revelation': not maximum data volume, but preserving task-relevant information through a constrained channel.
information_bottleneck_upgrade.boundary: Information-theoretic relevance is defined by a target variable/distribution; it does not determine spiritual truth by itself.

moon_reflection_model.astronomy: Moonlight is reflected sunlight; visible phase is relational geometry among Sun, Moon, Earth and observer.
moon_reflection_model.research_value: Reflection becomes a transfer function with gain, spectral dependence and geometry. Fidelity can be estimated rather than treated as an all-or-none symbolic property.
moon_reflection_model.project: Moon is a natural image of mediated visibility, recurrence, timing and secondary orientation.
moon_reflection_model.deep_rule: Reflected does not mean false; a mediator can preserve, distort, attenuate or filter a source.

spudlight_eye_door_circuit.chain: Source -> signal -> Eye/observation -> inference -> Door/decision -> changed state
spudlight_eye_door_circuit.formalization: x_source -> p(y|x) -> posterior p(x|y) or estimator x_hat -> policy/guard D -> x_next
spudlight_eye_door_circuit.insight: A signal becomes consequential only through a receiver/decision process; transmitted energy alone does not specify interpretation or action.
spudlight_eye_door_circuit.testable_question: Does adding the proposed signal variable improve prediction of state transitions relative to a model using existing inputs alone?

spudlight_vector.rigor_upgrade: Treat this as a typed record/feature bundle, not a vector in one metric space unless every component is transformed to a justified common representation.

variables.A_attn: attention metric defined by the chosen platform/experiment
variables.sigma_source: source/provenance quality score with explicit construction

spudlight_vector.rule: Never add or norm unlike components as though they share units without an explicit normalization/model and validation target.

center_and_graph_metrics.project_use: Father can be source/root center; Son/Door can have interface/betweenness centrality; O can be geometric/relational center; Moon can be orbital/circumferential mediator. These are different centrality types.
center_and_graph_metrics.rigor_rule: Choose centrality based on a process model. High degree, high betweenness and dynamical influence are not interchangeable.
center_and_graph_metrics.warning: Graph centrality is model-dependent and not proof of cosmic centrality.

experimental_instantiations.question: Can the transfer model predict measured received signal within uncertainty?
Which storage-release model best predicts temporal carbon allocation?
How much task-relevant information survives mediation?
Does a declared attention model predict transitions better than base-rate/network baselines?

falsification_and_failure_conditions: A claimed physical Spudlight effect is rejected if ordinary electromagnetic/thermal/biological mechanisms fully account for the observation and no residual, preregistered anomaly remains.
A storage model is revised if it fails mass/energy balance or cannot predict held-out stock/release trajectories.
An information model fails if its added latent source/channel structure is non-identifiable and does not improve predictive likelihood or decision performance.
Cross-domain unification remains structural rather than physical if no shared dimensionless law or derivation connects the domains.

historical_esoteric_sun_moon.summary: Agrippa, Picatrix and later Western esoteric systems contain source/solar and lunar/mediating correspondences that can be compared structurally with project symbolism. They do not validate an electromagnetic or astrophysical Spudlight mechanism.

research_questions: Choose one empirical domain and estimate the source/channel/storage parameters from real data.
Test whether the storage-release model predicts better than a simple exponential/linear baseline when nonlinearity is proposed.
For information applications, define the target variable that makes information 'relevant' before invoking an information bottleneck.
Recover exact primary uses of Tim=Sun, Tim=Center and Tim=Spudlight separately.
Keep physical light, information, social attention, occult correspondence and theology explicitly separated.
